    meta:
        description = "Detects dropped Cobalt Strike beacon DLL in %TEMP%"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malware_family = "CobaltStrike"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1055.012"

        $beacon_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{b1e5}" wide ascii

        all of them
}
